Class Goal

java.lang.Object
Actor
Goal
public class Goal extends Actor
The target the player guides the puck into. Has an open mouth (the scoring area) on one side and solid walls on the others.

    • getZIndex

      public int getZIndex()
      Description copied from class: Actor
      Gets the z-index, or depth value, of the actor, which determines whether it should drawn on top of or below other actors. Actors will be drawn in order by increasing z-index, so actors with higher z-indices will appear on top. This method should be overriden by child classes to return the z-index that corresponds to the specific type of actor.

      List of actors by their z-index:

      • 10: UniformEField
      • 11: UniformBField
      • 20: TotalEField
      • 21: TotalBField
      • 100: Switch
      • 110: Wire
      • 200: Goal
      • 210: Wall
      • 300: ChargeBag
      • 310: Charge (fixed)
      • 311: Charge (non-fixed)
      • 400: Puck
      Overrides:
      getZIndex in class Actor
      Returns:
      the draw order index
